extract_message_text: extract plain text from a message object that may contain string or dict parts in its content field
filter_messages_for_memory: filter a conversation message list to keep only user inputs and final assistant responses for memory updates
detect_correction: detect explicit user correction signals in the last six conversation turns using regex patterns
detect_reinforcement: detect explicit positive reinforcement signals in the last six conversation turns using regex patterns
summarize_message_processing: summarize the message_processing module that extracts text, filters messages, and detects correction and reinforcement signals
